title: Why Your Brain Lies to You
desc: Right now, as you watch this, your brain is lying to you. Not because it's broken, but because it's brilliant. Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through the gentle lies your brain tells every day: the hole in your vision, the gorilla nobody saw, memories rewritten by a single word, memories that never happened, flashbulb moments, choices you never made, the interpreter in your head, why we all feel above average, I knew it all along, when your eyes change what you hear, a rubber hand that feels like yours, déjà vu, when time stretches, honest placebos, the optimism bias, faces in the clouds, hearing your own name, the dress, and why all these lies are actually good news. We end with simple habits of mind and a slow wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like.
